config.dimdoors.doors.option.closeDoorBe: When true, Dimensional Doors will automatically close when the player enters their portal.
config.dimdoors.doors.option.doorList.do: A list of block ids for doors. If the door's item id is different than the block id, add that as well.
config.dimdoors.doors.option.doorList.mo: Enable - Only generate dimensional variants of these doors. Disable - Prevent generating dimensional variants of these doors
config.dimdoors.doors.option.doorList.to: Set overrides for enabling/disabling certain doors
config.dimdoors.doors.option.placeRiftsI: If enabled, breaking a door in creative mode will spawn a rift
config.dimdoors.dungeons.option.maxDunge: The depth at which limbo is located. If a Rift reaches any deeper than this while searching for a new destination, the player trying to enter the Rift will be sent straight to Limbo.
config.dimdoors.general.option.depthSpre: The scale of the dispersion when escaping from a pocket or limbo, in blocks/depth. Limbo is treated as depth 50.
config.dimdoors.general.option.enableDeb: When true, debug messages will be printed.
config.dimdoors.general.option.enableRif: When true, blocks around a growing rift will unravel over time.
config.dimdoors.general.option.endermanA: The chance that an enderman spawned by a detached rift attacks the closest player.
config.dimdoors.general.option.endermanS: The chance that an enderman spawns at a detached rift.
config.dimdoors.general.option.riftBound: When true, shows the bounding boxes of floating rifts when the player is in creative.
config.dimdoors.general.option.riftClose: The speed at which rifts close when using the rift remover, in units of rift size per tick.
config.dimdoors.general.option.riftGrowt: The speed at which rifts grow, in units of rift size per tick.
config.dimdoors.general.option.teleportO: Distance in blocks to teleport the player in front of the dimensional door.
config.dimdoors.graphics.option.highligh: How long, in milliseconds, the rift's core (tesseract animation) should be shown for when attempting to place a door near a large rift but not directly on it. Set to -1 to disable.
config.dimdoors.graphics.option.riftJitt: Multiplier affecting how much rifts should jitter, 1 being the default size.
config.dimdoors.graphics.option.riftSize: Multiplier affecting how large rifts should be rendered, 1 being the default size.
config.dimdoors.graphics.option.showRift: Set this to true to always show rifts' cores (tesseract animation).
config.dimdoors.limbo.option.decaySurrou: Does escaping limbo cause limbo decay around the location?
config.dimdoors.limbo.option.defaultToWo: When true, the world spawn of the world the player is escaping from limbo to will be used as the center of possible return location.
config.dimdoors.limbo.option.escapeTarge: Defines the id of the world players will spawn in upon exiting Limbo.  Leaving this blank will spawn players in the world their respawn point is in.
Defines the Y coordinate the player will spawn at when using "Escape To World"
config.dimdoors.limbo.option.escapeToWor: Boolean that determines if players exiting limbo will return relative to the worldspawn instead.  If true, escapeTargetWorld has no effect.
config.dimdoors.limbo.option.hardcoreLim: When true, a player dying in Limbo will respawn in Limbo, making Eternal Fluid or Golden Dimensional Doors the only way to escape Limbo.
config.dimdoors.limbo.option.limboBlocks: The radius around a player in which blocks can decay upon exiting limbo.
config.dimdoors.limbo.option.limboReturn: Distance from spawn that limbo returns you

Defines the maximum distance out the possible return locations can be from the target center.
 Setting both return distances to 0 cause the player to exactly appear at target center.

Defines the minimum distance out the possible return locations can be from the target center.
 Setting both return distances to 0 cause the player to exactly appear at target center.
config.dimdoors.limbo.option.tryPlayerBe: When true, the bed spawn of the player will be used as the center of possible return locations if available.
config.dimdoors.limbo.option.universalLi: When true, players are also teleported to Limbo when they die in any non-Pocket Dimension (except Limbo itself). Otherwise, players only go to Limbo if they die in a Pocket Dimension.
config.dimdoors.limbo.option.worldsLeadi: Boolean that determines if list is a blacklist or white list for worlds.
List of the ids for worlds in the blacklist/whitelist.
Defines a blacklist/whitelist of worlds that will send the player to limbo upon death.
config.dimdoors.monoliths.option.dangero: When true, Monoliths in Limbo attack the player and deal damage.
config.dimdoors.monoliths.option.monolit: When true, being exposed to the gaze of Monoliths for too long, will cause the player to be teleported to the void above Limbo.
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.asyncWorl: Sets loading pockets to your WorldEdit clipboard asynchronous or synchronous. Only affects when WorldEdit is installed.
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.blocksCol: The amount of blocks covered by a single dye whe dyeing a private pocket.
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.canUseRif: Can Use Rift Signature In Private Pockets
If Enabled, rift signatures can be used within private pockets.
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.classicPo: Default - Disabled but can be enabled, Default Enabled - Enabled but can be disabled, Always Enabled - Can not be disabled
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.defaultPo: Default - Disabled but can be enabled, Default Enabled - Enabled but can be disabled, Always Enabled - Can not be disabled
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.defaultWe: Sets the equation to be used to compute weight when there is no / invalid weight equation present in the pocket generator json
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.fallbackW: Sets the fallback weight to be used if the default weight equation fails.
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.maxPocket: Sets the maximum size of any pocket. A size of x will allow for pockets up to (x + 1) * (x + 1) chunks.
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.pocketGri: Sets how many chunks apart all pockets in any pocket dimensions should be placed.
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.privatePo: Sets the minimum size of a newly created Private Pocket. If this is set to any value bigger than maxPocketSize, the value of maxPocketSize will be used instead.
config.dimdoors.pockets.option.publicPoc: Sets the minimum size of a newly created Public Pocket. If this is set to any value bigger than privatePocketSize, the value of privatePocketSize will be used instead.
config.dimdoors.title: Dimensional Doors
config.dimdoors.world.option.clusterDimB: Dimension Blacklist for the generation of Rift Scar clusters. Add a dimension ID here to prevent generation in certain dimensions.
config.dimdoors.world.option.clusterGenC: Sets the chance (out of 1) that a cluster of rifts will generate in a given chunk.
config.dimdoors.world.option.gatewayDimB: Dimension Blacklist for the generation of Dimensional Portal gateways. Add a dimension ID here to prevent generation in certain dimensions.
config.dimdoors.world.option.gatewayGenC: Sets the chance (out of 1) that a dimensional gateway will generate in a given chunk.
